name: Brass
author: Lyle Mills, after Perry R. Cook and Gary P. Scavone
description: A lip-reed brass instrument. Breath makes it speak, and the lip knob climbs the bore's harmonic series the way a bugle player does.

controls.label: Lip
controls.description: Lip tension. Climbs the bore's partials, and bends each one sharp as it rises.

controls.label: Breath
controls.description: Breath pressure. Below the threshold the instrument does not speak, as a real one does not.

controls.label: Bell
controls.description: Bell size, from a stopped horn that barely sustains to an open one that overblows easily.

controls.label: Buzz
controls.description: How far the lips swing into closure each cycle -- a soft flutter against a real mouthpiece buzz.

outputs.aux: The valve flow -- the buzz that drives it.

upstream: After STK Brass (Cook's TBone/HosePlayer); redesigned because upstream does not sustain
